run: 2 of P1.58 (reopened by whip-lead 2026-11-23 for the unseen-cue test; 1 run, descriptive, $0 on the cluster debug QoS). Run 1: E282, experiments/gain_share/results/predictions.json (not edited), report reports/analyses/2026-11-23_analysis_p1-58-gain-share.md
code: experiments/gain_share/unseen.py (run 1's F, M, levels, fit and reads, run.py and commute.gain_fit, unchanged)

settings.controls_source: run 1's five controls, built as run 1 built them (run.py control); x2 and x10 first so their stop comes first
settings.kl_saved_source: run 1's (each F's KL(F || M) on all of D repeats the saved one before it is split)
settings.split_source: per state the keys (the token that decides the trained answer) over its fit and read rows, sorted, permuted with key_seed; the first half is fitted. Fit rows = run 1's fit rows of fitted keys; 'unseen' = run 1's read rows of the other keys; 'seen' = run 1's read rows of fitted keys (run 1's reading, at this fit). Keys: cue items the cue token A'_i at the last position, 8 cues -> 4 fitted (run 1's 256/256 window split, cue_split_seed 282002, gives 128 fit rows of 4 cues, about 128 unseen and 128 seen); copy24 (x2, x10) the token at half, 24 keys -> 12 (about 150 fit rows, about 37 unseen, 37 seen); E62 the key A at half - 1, 32 keys -> 16 (about 400 fit, 100 unseen, 100 seen). A half split: the fewest fitted keys (4 cues) still give the fit more than one key, and the unseen side keeps as many rows as the seen side, so the two read at the same sampling noise
settings.lr_source: run 1's (its departure from E231's 3e-3 is stated in run 1's predictions): at 0.1 the exact controls at N reached 0.997 and 0.981
settings.steps_source: run 1's loss curves (results/stage*/*.json curve, flat_rel): at 600 steps only 11 of 28 fits had a train-loss change under 0.05 over the last 100 steps; x2 at N 0.59, x10 at N 0.149, x2 at V 0.259, the head-gain-of-2 edit at N stopped at a KL share of 0.841 although an exact gain exists, and the VPD train KL was still falling at the end of most cosine schedules. 2000 steps (3.3x) is the longest horizon whose V job fits the debug QoS's 2 h with a margin: run 1 measured 0.140-0.161 s/step at V and 0.061-0.081 s/step at N on an L40 (results/stage*/*.json s_per_step), so a V fit takes 280-320 s and an N fit 120-160 s. Same warm-up share (5%) and cosine schedule as run 1; check_every 200 so flat_rel is the change over the last 200 steps (10% of the horizon, as run 1's 100 of 600 was 17%)
settings.fit_source: run 1's (batch 64 = E231's 32 doubled; grad_clip E231's; read_batch memory only)
settings.seeds_source: run 1's, so a state's rows and its fit's batches are drawn as in run 1 before the key filter

thresholds.thresholds_source: min_gain through gain_repro_rel: run 1's, unchanged (sources in run 1's predictions.json). exact_min: run 1's n_min; run 1 read x2 and x10 at N at KL shares 0.997 and 0.981 on held-out windows, and the key split does not change that an exact gain on eight neurons exists. new_max: run 1's bar for the new edits (low_v and the new_few_new_thin expectation, 0.3). The gate asks the two control classes to sit at least 0.6 apart (0.9 against 0.3) where run 1, on fitted cues, read them within 0.03 (exact 0.981-0.997 against new 0.967-0.969). smallest_gap: the card's 0.1. Noise floor, from what run 1 measured: the share's spread over E62's three fine-tune seeds of one map was 0.0054 (copy, N), 0.0020 (lookup, N), 0.0217 (copy, V), 0.0010 (lookup, V) (results/score.json); the two new-edit builds read 0.002 apart at N and 0.001 at V. Run 1 kept no per-row shares, so row sampling noise was not measured; the unseen and seen sides each hold about half of run 1's read rows, which at most doubles the variance, giving a floor of about 0.03 (sqrt 2 x 0.0217). Every bar sits at least 0.08 (x10's 0.981 against 0.9) from its expected reading, over twice that floor; smallest_gap 0.1 is over three times it

readings.share: per (state, level, row set): (mean over rows of the trained answer's log-odds at its position under G*, minus under M) / (the same for F), read only where F's gain on those rows is at least min_gain; run 1's
readings.kl_share: 1 - KL(F || G*) / KL(F || M) on those rows, read where KL(F || M) > kl_min; run 1's
readings.row_sets: unseen: read rows of keys the fit never saw (the scored reading); seen: read rows of fitted keys (run 1's reading at this fit); train: the fit rows (KL only)
readings.fit_record: per fit: flat_rel (the train-loss change between the last two checks, 200 steps apart, relative), KL(F || G*) on train, seen and unseen rows, the curve (its held_kl is on the first 64 unseen rows), s_per_step, peak GPU memory

blind_to: As run 1: which of M's variables carry G*'s gain, and a route F does not take that reaches F's answer; plus, here, whether a state that transfers to unseen keys does so by M's mechanism or by a gain pattern that happens to generalise over keys (an x2-like rescale is key-agnostic by construction). The cue items have 4 unseen cues: a share there is a mean over 4 answers. At V there is no exact positive control.
positive_control: x2 and x10 at N: exactly a gain of 2 or 10 on eight neurons, key-agnostic, so the fit must recover them on unseen keys: at least 0.95 expected, under exact_min (0.9) stops the job at once

expected.stage0: as run 1 (results/stage0.json): gains of 1 bit-identical to M and export exactly 0 (read true and 0); random gain state export at most 1e-3 (run 1 1.6e-5 at N, 1.2e-5 at V), shuffled at least 0.1 (run 1 1.40); do-nothing reads KL(F || M), F's gain and KL(F || G*) exactly 0 and moves no gain; at V the remainder identity at most 3e-6 (run 1 1.05e-6)
expected.x2_x10_N: unseen KL share at least 0.95 (run 1, fitted keys: 0.997, 0.981); seen within 0.03 of unseen; share not read (F's gain on the copy answer is under 1 log-odds: run 1 -0.11 and -2.09)
expected.random_N: unseen KL share about 0.27, between -0.2 and 0.5 (run 1, fitted cues: 0.269); the random change is not cue-specific, so unseen and seen about equal; descriptive, no rule
expected.new_few_new_thin_N: unseen share at most 0.3, near 0 (G* has seen no answer of the unseen cues, and F's answers are new tokens per cue); seen share about 0.95 (run 1: 0.967, 0.969); F's gain on unseen cues about 16.5 log-odds (run 1 all cues: 16.8, 16.5)
expected.gate_N: separated: x2, x10 at least 0.9 and both new edits at most 0.3 on unseen keys; else the job stops before E62
expected.e62_N: copy map: unseen share at least 0.8 (run 1, fitted keys: 0.998-1.008; its read windows already held B tokens never fitted, so copying transfers over the token that is copied); lookup: unseen share at most 0.3 (each key's word is its own, and the words were matched to M's low prior for B); gap at least 0.1, expected about 0.7; seen shares as run 1 (about 1.0 and 0.97)
expected.controls_V: descriptive (no exact control at V): x2, x10 unseen KL share about run 1's (0.909, 0.606) or higher at the longer fit; new edits unseen share at most 0.3; the random's KL share may be negative (run 1 -0.504)
expected.e62_V: descriptive: the same direction as N, gap at least 0.1
expected.fits: flat_rel under 0.05 on most fits (run 1: 11 of 28); unseen KL(F || G*) above train KL(F || G*) on every state that does not transfer; descriptive

rules.stop_exact: after x2 and after x10 at N: every reading it has on unseen keys (share where read, KL share where read) at least exact_min (0.9), else the job stops (exit 1)
rules.gate: after the five controls at N: separated = the stop_exact condition for x2 and x10 and the unseen share of new_few and of new_thin each at most new_max (0.3; a share not read or nan fails); not separated -> results/unseen/controls_N.json 'stopped', exit 1, and E62 is not read at either level
rules.gap: per level: gap = mean over read seeds of the copy map's unseen share minus the lookup's (seeds 0-2); a side with no read seed gives gap None
rules.P: gap >= smallest_gap (0.1): the unseen-key share separates the copy map from the lookup at that level; at V descriptive (no exact positive control)
rules.verdict: none: the definition is under revision (cell P1.1) and the card is descriptive; the run reports the gate, the two gaps and P per level

edge_cases.zero_denominator: F's gain under min_gain on a row set -> share None there, the state read by its KL share; KL(F || M) at or under kl_min -> KL share None
edge_cases.gate_share_missing: a new edit whose unseen share is None (F gains under 1 log-odds on unseen cues) or nan fails the gate: the run cannot say it reads low
edge_cases.exact_no_reading: x2 or x10 with no reading on unseen keys fails stop_exact
edge_cases.one_seed: a map with one read seed: its mean is that seed's share
edge_cases.ties: compared after rounding to 12 decimals; a reading exactly 0.9 passes exact_min (>=), exactly 0.3 passes new_max (<=), a gap exactly 0.1 counts (>=)
edge_cases.share_over_1_or_negative: read as it is, not clipped; a negative unseen share of a new edit is at most 0.3 and passes
edge_cases.empty_side: a split with no fit, seen or unseen row is refused at the split (assert): with 4-32 keys each with rows on both sides in run 1, none is expected
